purpose: Connect Adpick provider listings, exact merchant targets, observed prices and account-scoped link issuance for Vercel. Descriptions and implementation are separate from live account verification.

classes.identity: adpick + offer; offer is not a merchant product ID
sha256(provider buyurl); merchant SKU is null when not observed
exact observed public HTTP or HTTPS merchant URL; preserve option query; profit-link API issuance requires HTTPS

fields.priceKrw: groups[].list.price_sale parsed from plain or comma-formatted KRW strings
fields.evidencePeriod: startAt observedAt; endAt null unless observed

classes.identity: configured account digest + stored hub item + exact target URL
persistent UTC hour slot; each requested SDK has a source receipt

relations.rule: No target inferred from title or tracking-link clicks
Reserve durable intent before dispatch; attach only if current stored target still matches; independently read back

shoppingSdk.envelope: Vercel items contains a group array; each group contains list

sdkTrackingLink.originalTargetRule: preserve observed scheme; do not invent HTTPS for legacy HTTP products

runtime.sdkCadence: Alternating one successful SDK surface per UTC hour; known failed read-only collections may resume at most three times after 60-second cooldown; successful slots and uncertain link issues never repeat

invariants: Configured credentials do not prove live owner authentication.
Never store credentials or raw sessions in ontology.
Never infer sold-out from a missing rotating listing.
Unknown shipping never supports delivered-price-lowest claims.
Do not guess merchant, option, seller identity or campaign expiry.
Link response timeout requires reconciliation, never blind resend.
DB readback proves persistence/attachment; provider link management and conversion performance need independent evidence.

verification.ownerEvidence: task-owned native actor session and matching private link record IDs independently read from Vercel
verification.productEvidence: Vercel sdk-link issued one stored-product link; intent attached; result cache and exact target digest independently match
